title: Interception of Temporary Access Code
description: The temporary access code entered by the guest could be intercepted during transmission to the Home Hub if the communication channel is not encrypted.
assumptions: Assumes the transmission between Guest User and Home Hub may lack encryption.

title: Linking Access Code to Guest Identity
description: The Home Hub may log the temporary access code alongside guest identifiers, enabling linkage of access attempts to specific individuals.
assumptions: Assumes the Home Hub retains logs correlating access codes with guest identities.

title: Lack of Transparency in Data Processing
description: Guests may be unaware that their temporary access codes are being processed, stored, or logged by the Home Hub.
assumptions: Assumes no explicit notification or consent mechanism is in place for data handling.

title: Data Interception During Transmission
description: Video clips transmitted from Home Hub to cloud storage may be intercepted if not encrypted, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Exposure of Personally Identifiable Information
description: Stored video clips may contain PII (e.g., faces, license plates) that could be linked to individuals if the cloud storage is compromised.
assumptions: Video content includes identifiable individuals or objects

title: Lack of User Awareness About Data Processing
description: Users may not be informed that their camera clips are being uploaded to cloud storage, violating transparency principles.
assumptions: No explicit user consent or notification mechanism

title: Non-Compliance with Data Protection Regulations
description: Cloud storage provider may not adhere to legal requirements (e.g., GDPR) for handling video data.
